chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Khalid al-Qammat, from Durays, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him (peace be upon him) saying that women have been given twelve parts of desire and twelve parts of patience.
ai.seo_question: What are the twelve parts of desire and patience given to women according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) quantifies the female constitution as possessing twelve portions of desire (*budh'*) and twelve of patience (*sabr*), a metric often interpreted by Shia scholars as indicating a heightened emotional and physical sensitivity that necessitates greater spiritual fortitude. This comparison serves not merely as a biological observation but as a theological basis for understanding the distinct spiritual trials and rewards assigned to women, emphasizing that their patience is equally, if not more, significant in the context of Islamic jurisprudence and ethics.
